blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Z. Duterte should show documents proving that she had given up her business positions and interests after assuming office in 2022, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House impeachment adviser and spokesperson, said in a press briefing on Wednesday. Barbers said Duterte should address discrepancies in her statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs), corporate filings, and tax records. “If everything is clean, this is easy to answer,” Barbers said in Filipino.
